prd.overview: This project aims to develop a fan page dedicated to Final Fantasy 7, featuring key characters, weapons, and an interactive game map. The site will serve as a hub for fans to explore character details, weapon information, and navigate the game's world.
goals: Provide detailed profiles for main characters like Cloud, Barret, and Tifa.
Include a comprehensive section for weapons with descriptions and stats.
Implement an interactive map of the game world for user navigation.
Ensure the site is visually appealing and aligns with the Final Fantasy 7 theme.
Optimize the site for both desktop and mobile users.
non_goals: Develop a full-fledged game or interactive gameplay experience.
Include content unrelated to Final Fantasy 7.
Create a trading or financial dashboard.
Implement user accounts or login features.
target_users: Final Fantasy 7 fans looking for character and game information.
Gamers interested in exploring the lore of Final Fantasy 7.
New players seeking guidance on weapons and game navigation.
core_features_mvp: Character profiles for Cloud, Barret, and Tifa with images and descriptions.
Weapons section with a list of weapons, their stats, and images.
Interactive game map that allows users to click on locations for more information.
Responsive design for optimal viewing on various devices.
Search functionality to quickly find characters or weapons.
nice_to_have_features: User-generated content section for fan art and stories.
Forum or comment section for fan discussions.
Integration of social media sharing options.
Video content showcasing gameplay or character analysis.
Merchandise links for fans to purchase related items.
user_stories: As a fan, I want to view detailed profiles of Cloud, Barret, and Tifa so that I can learn more about their backgrounds and abilities.
As a user, I want to explore a section dedicated to weapons so that I can understand their stats and how they can be used in the game.
As a visitor, I want to interact with a game map so that I can familiarize myself with the locations in Final Fantasy 7.
As a fan, I want to search for specific characters or weapons so that I can quickly find the information I need.
As a user, I want the site to be visually appealing and themed around Final Fantasy 7 so that it enhances my experience.
As a mobile user, I want the site to be responsive so that I can access it easily on my phone.
As a fan, I want to share my favorite character profiles on social media so that I can engage with other fans.
As a visitor, I want to leave comments on character profiles to share my thoughts and opinions.
acceptance_criteria: All character profiles are complete with images and descriptions.
The weapons section is fully functional with accurate stats and images.
The interactive map is operational and provides information on click.
The site passes usability testing on both desktop and mobile devices.
Search functionality returns relevant results for characters and weapons.
technical_stack_recommendation: HTML/CSS for front-end structure and styling.
JavaScript for interactive elements like the map.
React or Vue.js for building a dynamic user interface.
Node.js for server-side logic if needed.
MongoDB or similar for storing character and weapon data.
payments_security_compliance: Ensure compliance with GDPR for user data protection if user-generated content is implemented.
Follow best practices for web security to protect against data breaches.
Implement SSL for secure data transmission.
assumptions: The client will provide all necessary images and content for characters and weapons.
The site will not require user authentication or accounts at launch.
The project will be developed within a standard web development timeline.
